note: atlas-main18 repin (2026-11-27): Atlas main 0.3.19 (boundless-atlas 91f004e), asi d09ee22f, oop plugin 08f6bb06, script half atlas-main18-1127. atlas-predict-1127: Boundless Atlas docs/050 predictive staged streaming (PS-8), feature/predictive-streaming-1127. Three jobs on Sunset Valley new games, order matters: the born off arm writes the skip list (setup), then arm A (Predict=0, reactive) and arm B (Predict=1) of the born route visit. M-2 smoke = arm B's read-back lines (native start line and script-on line with the same values, stream group registered, summary with plans >= 1 and faults 0); M-3 = arms A vs B on the visit (household wait from the born pagein lines; arm C HorizonS=10 and the M-4 dense-downtown world wait for recorded tracks). Needs queue key extraAsi, game-copy/atlas-predict-1127/atlas.asi (sha256 pinned) and game-copy/mod-sets/atlas-predict-1127. Dry run only; not run (written 2026-11-27).
